messages:
sophia: Quick Q — we have an IC -> manager promotion for Taylor. Manager wants effective date 2026-03-01. Need clarity on: payroll cutoff vs effective date, backpay process/timeline, bonus target proration for Q1, and equity grant timing. Can we do the promotion effective 3/1 and get backpay in the next payroll?
raj: For payroll: effectivity in HR system before the payroll cutoff gets reflected in that run. If the change posts after cutoff, it will hit the following pay. We can do an off-cycle adjustment for backpay, but need the signed comp form + manager approval + GL code.
marcus: Compensation note: base salary can be backdated in our records to 3/1 for comp reporting. Bonus target proration = (days after effective / total days in quarter) * target, per usual. Equity: manager-level grant needs comp committee approval; grant date usually matches the promotion effective date but paperwork can delay issuance.
taylor: OK. So to confirm: if I want 3/1 as the effective date and want backpay on the next pay, what are the deadlines?
sophia: @raj @marcus can you confirm specific cutoffs and what we need from the manager to hit the off-cycle?
raj: Off-cycle payroll window for this run is Wed 2026-03-12. To make that, submit by Mon 2026-03-09 COB with: signed "Comp Change Request" PDF, manager approval email, employee ID, new salary and GL code. If you miss it, next regular run is Thu 2026-03-26. Backpay is usually a single lump-sum line item; we calculate by days and pay difference.
marcus: Comp committee meets Tue 2026-03-10. To be on agenda for the manager RSU grant, we need the full comp packet by Mon 3/9 as well: current comp, proposed comp, rationale, org chart snapshot, and approvals. If comp committee doesn't sign off in time, you can still change title/ salary but equity will be delayed.
elan: Benefits/ops note: title and salary changes mid-month don't retroactively change coverage eligibility. Payroll date governs deductions/401k deferrals. For manager-specific programs (e.g., manager training stipend), OPS will activate based on the HR system effective date once payroll sends the job change.
taylor: Got it. One more: what happens to Q1 variable comp already accrued (they closed some deals in Feb)? Will changing target affect that?
marcus: Commission/bonus already earned under the plan is paid per the plan rules. Changing target on 3/1 will prorate future awards for the quarter; it does not claw back already-earned commissions.
payroll-bot: Reminder: attach signed Comp Change Request PDF and Manager Approval email when submitting to payroll@redwood.com. Use GL code prefix `HR-OP-` + 3 digits.
sophia: Summary/action items — Taylor: gather sign-offs and route comp packet to @marcus + @sophia by Mon 2026-03-09 COB; Marcus: confirm proposed salary and target proration numbers; Raj: confirm GL code and ready off-cycle; Elan: confirm benefits activation checklist. I'll post a short checklist doc after this thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
